Currently emergency-kill-btn lives inside Settings.jsx (L108-120), not on the Workspace section header, so visual alignment vs the outer 'Engine & Risk' title cannot be tuned from Workspace.jsx. Consider hoisting the kill button into the Section header of Workspace.jsx L50-53 to match the mock.

Mobile: RN Switch renders as an inline element in Expo web preview and Playwright's is_visible() can return False for adjacent Pressables inside the same Card even when the element is rendered (text_content works). Not a bug, but future testing agents should prefer text_content / query_selector over is_visible for RN Switch / Pressable-wrapping-View combos in the manual-order-card.

Cockpit BotBrainStrip (Dashboard.jsx L120-134) does not add per-cell data-testid on the web 2x2 matrix (MatrixCell has no testid). Mobile has cockpit-metric-setups/scanned/rejected/qualified. Consider parity: add cockpit-metric-{key} testids on web MatrixCell too so future tests can assert individual values without regex-parsing text.
